description: Automated dependency updates for backup-to-proton-drive via the Mend Renovate GitHub App. Pins Docker and GitHub Action digests, keeps Node.js on 26.x, enforces a 3-day npm release cooldown, runs weekly, and requires manual PR review.

packageRules.description: Wait 3 days after npm package publication before raising PRs to reduce supply-chain risk from compromised or quickly yanked releases.
Keep Node.js runtime images, Node engines, and @types/node aligned with Node.js 26.x until an intentional runtime upgrade.
Group @protontech/drive-sdk and @protontech/crypto updates into one PR so tightly coupled Proton SDK and OpenPGP cryptographic updates are typechecked and tested together.
Group non-major npm devDependency updates (build and typecheck tooling) into a single weekly PR while keeping major versions separate for careful review.
Group GitHub Actions workflow digest and version updates into a single weekly PR to avoid workflow PR noise.
